Mira: Heads-up — competitor X shipped a 'context-aware summarizer' today. Internal thread to decide if we: 1) parity ship quickly, 2) focus our differentiator roadmap, or 3) hybrid (parity + unique controls). :eyes:
Kai: saw it. Their UX is slick but backend looks expensive. pricing page says >$0.10/req at scale.
Sanjay: any signal from pilot customers?
Mira: ACME pilot pinged yesterday — asked if we have a match. They care about predictable latency and audit logs more than novelty.
Lee: from infra POV parity will require a small infra spike for prefix caching + a new quantized variant. Estimate ~3w eng + 1w QA for an MVP.
